purpose: Compare complete rank/absolute-return/hybrid pipelines with explicit cash option
model: Ridge; monthly two-year rolling; shared completed rows as prior compare_targets; all current-eligible rows predicted
inner_validation: last63 training decision dates; fit label_end strictly before first inner date
absolute_selection: minimum mean daily MSE in gross price-return units

feature_blocks.market_augmented: same45 plus causal IMOEX returns5/21 and logreturn sigma20; secondary sensitivity for both models

costs: net expectation=(1+gross)*(1-c)/(1+c)-1; c=sidebps/10000; no separate constant-shift target training

policies.rank_always: rank ordering; entries top5; retain rank<=10
policies.return_always: absolute expectation ordering; entries top5; retain rank<=10; no cash gate control
policies.return_cash: absolute ordering; entry net>0; hold gross>0 and rank<=10
policies.rank_cash: rank ordering; same absolute-model entry/hold gates

cash_sizing: five slots; available cash divided by planned vacancy count; gated/unfilled slots remain cash; no replacement beyond preselected top5
execution: existing next-open retention engine; all policies cash_allocation=vacancy_slots; fixed quantities; predeclared final-close liquidation; original quotes primary
primary_contrast: base rank_cash vs base rank_always at10bps
uncertainty: exploratory paired bootstrap of monthly mean daily-return differences,10000 samples,seed20261110; no significance/independent-test claim
limits: same inspected development periods; adaptive research
rank usesIC tuning and absolute usesMSE: compare full pipelines, not isolated target effect
fees alter gate and trades: cost scenarios not pure fee sensitivity
5-session forecast is rolling signal; variable actual holding; gross>0 holdgate heuristic
zero cash interest, idealized OHLC netting and fractional shares
retrospective35-ticker universe; conditional training outcomes; missing exits/stale quotes remain visible

execution_quote_scenarios.original: primary; unresolved positions invalidate realized returns
execution_quote_scenarios.custody: sensitivity; verified AGRO/FIXP successor prices conditional on successful custody conversion, liquidation only
